resources.string: Pick a video already saved on this device, frame the watermark, then export.
Removes the visible watermark (logo, text): the video must already be on the phone.
Metadata and invisible characters only — does not remove a visible watermark.
From the gallery or via \"Share\" from another app.
Move the box, tune the method and compare before / after.
The video is saved to the gallery and to \"My videos\".
100% on-device processing, no video is ever uploaded.
Only use this tool on videos you own the rights to.
Remove provenance traces without uploading the file.

The Android pass natively covers the deterministic cleaners: text/Unicode, HTML, Markdown, LaTeX, SVG, XML/JSON, images, audio, ISO-BMFF containers and ZIP archives. Pixels, visible text and audio samples stay untouched: a visible watermark (logo, burned-in text) is therefore not removed here — go back home and use \"Choose a video\" for that.
PDF is cleaned without a qpdf rewrite: Info and XMP metadata are handled, but attachments and embedded-image metadata may need a desktop tool.

This file carries neither provenance metadata (C2PA, EXIF, XMP) nor invisible characters: the result is identical to the original, which is expected. If it shows a VISIBLE watermark (logo, burned-in text), this screen cannot remove it: go back home and use \"Choose a video\".
An identical copy was saved to Downloads / Watermark Remover.
The local audit runs again after every change and previews possible leftovers.
Turn this off to keep metadata that does not look like provenance.
Replaces unusual Unicode spaces with a regular space.
Harmonizes compatibility forms; some visible characters may change.
Converts full-width letters and a few Cyrillic/Latin confusions.
Aggressive mode: complex emoji may change appearance.
Use only when the text does not rely on right-to-left ordering.
Videos you remove a watermark from will show up here. They are also saved to Movies/Watermark Remover.
\"%1$s\" will be removed from the library and deleted from the gallery. This cannot be undone.
Move and resize the box so it fully covers the watermark. Press and hold the image to see the original.
Add at least one zone to process.
Recovers the real picture behind the watermark by analysing the whole video (semi-transparent logo inverted pixel by pixel); opaque parts are rebuilt from their surroundings.
Analysing the video to recover the picture behind the watermark… %1$d %%
Watermark identified: the original picture behind it will be restored.
No static watermark detected in the frame: the area will be rebuilt from its surroundings.
The video analysis starts as soon as the frame is in place.
Heavily blurs the area. The watermark becomes unreadable but the area stays visible.
Replaces the area with large pixels.
Cuts the video to exclude the area. Changes the video dimensions.
Crop only uses the first zone.
Automatic maximum quality export: twice the original bitrate, resolution and frame rate preserved, audio copied losslessly.
Keep the app open while processing.
The video has been saved to the gallery and added to \"My videos\".
%1$s update • installs over the current version, your videos are kept.
Installs over the current version, your videos are kept.
Android asks for a one-time permission so the app can install its own updates.
You already have the latest version.
